run_coco_extract: run coco_extract to parse COCO-WholeBody annotations and save keypoints to an NPZ file
run_loadFoot: run loadFoot to load and filter foot keypoints from a CMU foot annotation JSON file
refactor_coco_extract: refactor coco_extract to change the minimum body joint threshold from 12 to a custom value
review_coco_extract: review coco_extract to understand how body, face, hand, and foot keypoints are extracted and stored
summarize_coco_extract: summarize coco_extract which reads COCO-WholeBody JSON annotations and outputs an NPZ file with keypoints
